Container.Name: Scryer
Container.Overview: Scryer is a self-hosted media management application for movies, TV series, and anime. It monitors libraries, searches through pluggable providers, evaluates releases, coordinates downloads and imports, organizes files, and manages subtitles.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: movies tv series anime sonarr radarr media automation subtitles
Container.Requires: Internet access for metadata and any configured indexer or download-client providers.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: HTTP port for the Scryer web interface.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent database, settings, metadata, and encryption key.

Config.Name: Movies Library
Config.Description: Optional host directory containing or receiving managed movies.

Config.Name: Series Library
Config.Description: Optional host directory containing or receiving managed TV series.

Config.Name: Anime Library
Config.Description: Optional host directory containing or receiving managed anime.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID used to own /config and run Scryer.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID used to own /config and run Scryer.

Config.Name: Require Login
Config.Description: Require Scryer login instead of using the built-in administrator session.
